title: Improve user-visible deployment diagnostics and backend availability checks for 'Failed to load stories'

requirements.text: Add an explicit backend availability check and expose it to the frontend so the app can distinguish between (a) backend canister unreachable / not yet propagated and (b) application-level errors.

quotes: yes why is taking so long

acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides a lightweight public method (e.g., health/ping) that returns immediately when the canister is reachable.
Frontend calls this method when the feed load fails and uses the result to label the error as either 'Backend unreachable/not propagated' vs 'Backend reachable but request failed'.
When the backend is unreachable, the UI messaging explicitly suggests propagation delay and next steps (wait, retry, try raw URL), rather than a generic error.

requirements.text: Improve the 'Failed to load stories' error state on the stories feed to show actionable troubleshooting and canister details (frontend asset canister ID, backend API canister ID when available, standard URL, raw URL), and provide one-click actions.

quotes:
Failed to load stories
There was an error loading the stories. This could be due to a connection issue or the backend service being unavailable.
yes why is taking so long

acceptanceCriteria: On the Feed page error state, display a clear heading and short explanation that the website loaded but the backend may be unavailable or still propagating.
Include buttons/links: Retry now, Open Troubleshooting page, and Open raw.icp0.io URL (when detectable).

Display detected canister info using existing canister resolution utilities (frontend canister ID/source, backend canister ID when available, standard/raw URLs) with copy-to-clipboard actions or a clear path to copy (can reuse existing UI patterns from TroubleshootingPage).
All user-facing text is in English and avoids vague messages like only 'Failed to load stories' without next steps.

requirements.text: Update retry/backoff behavior for fetching published stories to reduce perceived slowness and provide clear progress feedback during the first ~10–15 seconds after page load when the backend is not yet reachable.

quotes: shows the message after about 1–2 seconds
yes why is taking so long

acceptanceCriteria: When the backend request fails, the UI shows a visible 'Retrying…' / 'Checking backend…' state rather than immediately settling into a static failure state after 1–2 seconds.
Retry timing uses a backoff strategy (increasing delays) up to a reasonable cap, and stops after a finite number of attempts with a final actionable error state.
A manual 'Retry now' action is always available in the final error state.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components).
Do not modify immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if an upgrade requires state migration.
nonGoals: Do not add third-party monitoring, logging services, or external uptime checks.
Do not change authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
